speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: North. Past the Rother Market. We said Thursday, and it is Thursday.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The chimney is still standing. I told you the weeds were in it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Twenty houses and barns. Nobody was hurt. You will see it is smaller than a letter, and you will see it is worse near to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then show it. I am not bringing a better count than yours.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The nail stays in the pocket. The row can be the row without it.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Grandfather is already choosing a rung, if the street is to be believed.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Believed or not, the count is still twenty, and still nobody hurt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty, and nobody hurt. I will not improve either half of it when I see the ash.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I ran to the top of the street that day. Uncle Richard turned me back. The nail is from the ground since, and it is not a second errand.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The widow's hens are not in this walk. I did that voice on Saturday. Today is the chimney.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Order first. The cry was about two. The wind was in the south-west. Then the bell. Then the buckets. Then the dark, and twenty, and nobody hurt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had it from you on Saturday. I am here to see it, not to be told it a fourth time.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Then walk. The Rother Market is the turn, and the plots are after the turn.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: If you say it is not as bad as London made it, I will show you the weeds until you take it back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will say what I see. I have not said it yet.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Smaller than the fear, worse than five lines. If both are true you may say both. If one is false I will say so.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: And no picking. I have the nail I have.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The chimney does not need a new nail to be a chimney.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No picking. No new count. Show me the end of it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The end plot is a barn that is not a barn now. You will know it by the square of the ground.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: We stop where Grandfather is shouting. That is the middle, not the end.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Come on. The ash smells before you see it, and I want you to smell it before you make a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can smell it. I am not making the speech yet.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Then the speech can wait on the looking. Twenty. Nobody hurt. Walk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty. Nobody hurt. I am walking.
